hypotheses_validated.claim: MAJOR (verifier) fixed: every spec-level store behaviour the verifier's targeted mutants showed as untested is now covered, deterministically where order matters.
hypotheses_validated.evidence: store.c gained a test seam hx_store_set_read_hook (not in hx_store.h): a per-store hook called on the reader thread before every read attempt, outside the lock; it may block or fail the attempt and sees the file index and whether the handle is unbuffered. New tests: promotion (queued prefetch demanded -> read next and once; prefetch demanded while in flight is held: with all other slots acquired/held a further demand waits instead of evicting it), protection (LRU: unused prefetch outlives unprotected slabs, use or a tick ends it, wasted counted; LFU: when the 8-slot sample holds only protected slabs the full scan still evicts the single unprotected one), seeded_heat (profile changes LFU victim choice vs a control run; seeded heat on the r/(1-decay) scale via the prefetch hot rule at rates 0.4 vs 0.6 per token), pf_queue_limit (1 and 5 readers: exactly in-flight + max(2*top_k, 2*n_io, 4) hints accepted, the rest dropped and re-hintable), pin_cap (pin_fraction 0.9 at min+6 slots pins exactly n_slots-min, then top-k bursts complete; warm start with n_slots+3 profiled experts fills exactly the unpinned slots), direct_vs_buffered now asserts the handle mode seen by the hook (direct_io 1 -> all unbuffered when the platform grants it for the file, 0 -> all buffered). Scratch driver with the verifier's mutants, each applied alone to store.c, run against test_store --quick: T2 direct_io ignored, T3 no queued promotion, T8 protection kept on use, T10 protection never expires, T12 pin cap removed, T15 seeded heat zeroed, T16 queue bound off by one, T16b queue unbounded (crash), T19 no hold on in-flight promotion: all KILLED (T12 by an assertion in 4 s, not by the 60 s watchdog).

hypotheses_validated.claim: Minor (verifier) addressed within the current contract: one failed read no longer disables an expert for the store's lifetime and polling cannot spin.
hypotheses_validated.evidence: failed[] now has FAIL_NOW (cleared at hx_store_tick) and FAIL_EVER (only quiets repeated logs). Within a token, acquire/try_acquire of a failed expert return NULL without queuing reads; after the next tick it is read again. hx_store_wait_any now waits out its timeout even with nothing pending (the header's literal contract). A failed prefetch never marks the expert. Tests (read hook injects failures): acquire NULL with >= 2 attempts, wait_any(30 ms) took >= 30 ms, no re-read in the same token after the device recovers, correct bytes after a tick, a demand right after a failed prefetch succeeds; mirror failover in both directions (failure only on copy 0, then only on copy 1: the attempt moves to the other copy and returns correct bytes; gen-001 had left this unexercised). Mutants: tick does not clear, wait_any returns when idle, no failover, failed prefetch marks the expert: all KILLED.

hypotheses_validated.claim: Minor (verifier) addressed: a usage profile can no longer block hx_store_open.
hypotheses_validated.evidence: A missing, wrong-size, wrong n_layers/n_experts, bad magic/version, NaN/negative/infinite, truncated or over-long profile, or a directory given as usage_in, is ignored with a WARN log; nothing is taken from it (validated fully before use: a mutant that applies entries before validation is KILLED); when usage_out names the same file it is replaced by a valid profile on close. test_store 'bad usage' now asserts open succeeds, pinned 0, resident 0, heat all 0, and the file is valid after close.
